liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Turn On Your Love Light** (3 reviews): Runs 31 minutes; this reviewer treats it as the high point of the whole show; Follows a frantic Not Fade Away; includes a fast St. Stephen tease that surprises the band [8][10][13]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): The acoustic version is called insanely beautiful [12]
- **All I Ever Wanted** (1 review): Garcia's steel guitar solo with the New Riders is singled out as beautiful [11]
- **Easy Wind** (1 review): Easy Wind and Dire Wolf are named among the standouts of the Dead's set [11]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Cryptical Envelopment into The Other One into Cosmic Charlie is named a standout [11]
- **Frozen Logger** (1 review): A rare song, played in cut form, taken as a sign the band was loose [10]
- **Good Lovin?** (1 review): Described as outstanding, nearly equal to the May 2 version [7]
- **Uncle John?s Band** (1 review): Called spot-on, with excellent, strong harmonies [12]

## Setlist highlights

- **DonÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂt Ease Me In**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]
- **level setting**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]

- **Uncle JohnÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂs Band**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]
- **Six Days On The Road**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 13 archived performances [17]
- **I DonÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂt Know You**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]
- **WorkinÃÂÃÂÃÂÃÂ Man Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]
- **All I Ever Wanted**: rare: 9 archived performances [17]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Portland Woman, Honky Tonk Woman [17]

## The recordings

- **gd70-05-07.aud.weiner-gdADT04.5439.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 50 songs; 267 min; rated 3.94/5 by 16 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the audience recording's audio not great; Hissy audience recording, but the music rewards listening past the noise; Instrument isolation is poor on the recording, but the reviewer says not to be scared off [5][7][12]
- **gd1970-05-07.aud.sirmick.32276.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 45 songs; 267 min; rated 3.25/5 by 12 [2]. Said about its sound: Sound is pretty good for its era; Dead audience source sounds decent for the era; the New Riders disc is hissier and less clear [13][15]
- **gd1970-05-07.141093.aud.weiner.dalton.miller.sirmick.flac1644**: audience recording; 41 songs; 266 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1970-05-07.141093.aud.weiner.dalton.miller.sirmick.set3-retracked.flac1644**: audience recording; 42 songs; 266 min [4]

## Around the show

- Small crowd sat on the gym floor; Pigpen was absent for a stretch [5]
- Evening ran as three sets: acoustic Dead, New Riders, then electric Dead [5]
- Bobby giggles after King Bee and announces a five-minute break while the band decides what to play [10]
- The acoustic set is described as laid back [15]
- Felt like a high school sock hop in a gym; stage barely above the dancers on the floor [16]
- Show ran from about 8:30 until about 3:30 in the morning [16]
- A friend wanted The Eleven; Garcia asked between songs whether anyone had a number [16]
- David Nelson was introduced on guitar for Black Peter [2]
- Dead here sound youthful and passionate, unlike the 1990s band the reviewer saw [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-05-07.aud.weiner-gdADT04.5439.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Noah Weiner; source: Audience [1]. Also: Taper, mics and deck unknown; chain goes through reel and DAT, with an analog-to-digital transfer by Noah Weiner [1]
- **gd1970-05-07.aud.sirmick.32276.sbeok.flac16**: source: this is a remaster of shnid 5439 [2]. Also: Remastered with iZotope; dropouts repaired, static reduced, and patches made from David Hollister's seeded source [2]
- **gd1970-05-07.141093.aud.weiner.dalton.miller.sirmick.flac1644**: taped by Tim Dalton and Noah Weiner; transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick; source: Source: Audience Cassette Master > Reel > PCM (Sony HG) - Provided by Tim Dalton; Transfer: PCM > Sony SL-10 > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro >… [3]
- **gd1970-05-07.141093.aud.weiner.dalton.miller.sirmick.set3-retracked.flac1644**: taped by Tim Dalton; transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick; source: Source: Audience Cassette Master > Reel > PCM (Sony HG) - Provided by Tim Dalton; Transfer: PCM > Sony SL-10 > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro >… [4]
